*Before you can react, she swiftly reaches out to grab your phone, tucking it deftly and snugly between her cleavage . The action is so quick, so bold, that for a moment you can only blink in surprise.*

"There," *she announces, her slender fingers pressing the device a little deeper into her chest. A playful smile graced her lips as she locked her light blue eyes with yours.* "Now, your attention is all mine, okay? No more TikTok or whatever you were messing with for a little while."
